subject: VARIANCE function
notes: Rule text re-derived from specs/ISO_COBOL.md line 33974: `FUNCTION VARIANCE ( { argument-1 } ... )` -- FUNCTION and VARIANCE underlined (required), the parenthesised list not bracketed (required), the braced argument-1 followed by an ellipsis (one or more, repeatable). Each element located: (1) the surface shape is the shared Frontend rule src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Frontend/Grammar/Core/CobolExpressions.g4#functionCall -- `FUNCTION functionName (FNARG_LPAREN functionArgList? FNARG_RPAREN)? refModPart*` -- with functionArgList = `functionArgument (FNARG_SEPARATOR? functionArgument)*`, so space- and comma/semicolon-separated repeats both parse; VARIANCE is not in reservedIntrinsicArgFn (only SIGN and SUM are) so it takes the generic FUNCTION-keyword arm. (2) The VARIANCE-specific half is the catalog row read at IntrinsicCatalog.cs line 140: Add(new("VARIANCE", IntrinsicType.Numeric, IntrinsicArity.Variadic, 1, inf, "n", "Variance", IntrinsicBind.Runtime, true, 85)) -- MinArgs 1, MaxArgs int.MaxValue. (3) That bound is ENFORCED, not decorative: IntrinsicBinder.cs#BindIntrinsicCore lines 572-579 compute `given` (a table(ALL) argument counted as its static element count) and raise COBOL1504 "takes at least 1 argument(s)" outside [MinArgs, MaxArgs], so the format's minimum-one is a real rejection. (4) The ellipsis itself is mechanically pinned: IntrinsicSig.RepeatsAnArgument (IntrinsicCatalog.cs line 69) is `MaxArgs == int.MaxValue`, and IntrinsicRepeatedArgumentDriftTests.RepeatsAnArgument_IsExactly_TheFormatsEllipsis READS specs/ISO_COBOL.md, extracts the '#### 15.98.2 General format' block and asserts the catalog row agrees with whether that block contains a literal ellipsis -- a genuinely spec-derived test covering VARIANCE (it iterates every catalogued row, floor >= 79). RepeatsAnArgument is also the ISO 15.3 precondition that admits the ALL subscript, and both render lanes consume the enumerated list as one array (IntrinsicRenderer.cs#ArgArray via DecArgList line 517 and the RenderFloat default arm line 403), so `FUNCTION VARIANCE(TBL(ALL))` is structurally supported. Positive exercise of the written format: tests/conformance/2023/pb56_dec_carrier_intrinsics.cob line 39, `COMPUTE VA = FUNCTION VARIANCE(1, 2, 3)`, registered enabled in tests/conformance/2023/manifest.json line 123. Editions: Annex E (spec lines 42847-44200) carries NO VARIANCE or STANDARD-DEVIATION entry, so there is no edition delta; VARIANCE is in the section 8.11 intrinsic-function-name list (spec line 9710) and is an original Intrinsic Function Module name -- editions left at the batch default, NOT read off the catalog row's IntroducedIn. NOT tested for VARIANCE specifically: the table(ALL) form (pb62_all_subscript_runtime_ranges does not name VARIANCE) and the zero-argument rejection. || REFUTER (independently re-derived; verdict UPHELD as CONFORMS). Format re-read at specs/ISO_COBOL.md line 33974 -- FUNCTION and VARIANCE underlined, list unbracketed, `{ argument-1 } ...`. Grammar confirmed at CobolExpressions.g4 line 333 (functionCall) and lines 351-353 (functionArgList); reservedIntrinsicArgFn at line 343 is SIGN and SUM only, so VARIANCE takes the FUNCTION-keyword arm as claimed. The argument-less shape genuinely reaches the arity gate rather than a zero-argument path: BindIntrinsic line 89 calls BindIntrinsicCore(name, ArgsOf(fc.functionArgList())) and ArgsOf returns [] when the optional paren group is absent, so `FUNCTION VARIANCE` draws COBOL1504 -- and the section 8.4.3.2.3 SR6 pre-check at line 87 only diverts a `NAME (start:length)` shape. TWO ATTACKS TRIED AND DEFEATED. (i) Reference modification of a NUMERIC function result -- the general format shows none and the grammar's `refModPart*` admits the tokens -- is rejected: IntrinsicBinder.cs#ResultRefMod lines 180-185 admits only ResultCategory Alphanumeric/National/Boolean and reports COBOL1629 citing section 8.4.3.3.3 SR2, so `FUNCTION VARIANCE(1 2 3)(1:2)` is loud. (ii) The grammar's OMITTED alternative inside functionArgument is not a hole in the format: IntrinsicBinder.cs lines 2452-2456 report COBOL1544 citing section 8.4.3.2 SR7. The ellipsis's real consequence (the section 15.3 ALL subscript) is generic and driven by sig.RepeatsAnArgument at TryBindAllArgument line 2578, the element enumerates row-major in CobolTable.cs#AllArgs, and the zero-occurrence case that section 15.3 leaves undefined is defined LOUD there (EC-ARGUMENT-FUNCTION + CobolFatalException, lines 130-135) -- so no VARIANCE body can be entered with an empty list today. Editions re-checked independently: a scan of the Annex E range finds no VARIANCE or STANDARD-DEVIATION row, so the batch default stands and agrees with the landed sibling rows FMT-15.62.2 and FMT-15.74.2. ONE DRIFT RISK RECORDED, NOT A DEFECT: the drift test pins only the MAX half of the format (MaxArgs unbounded <-> the ellipsis); nothing mechanical holds MinArgs against the format's BRACES, so a catalog edit to MinArgs 0 would leave every test named here green.
